g.title: real
g.text: Full originals and credits; missing descriptions flagged

g.title: describe
g.text: Eight axes · observed parameters · photographic genre

g.title: composition
g.text: REAL observed · SLOP intended · SLOP observed
Distance and permutation test per feature and combination

g.title: lists
g.text: Model proposal from observed values (1 call) · owner approval
Fixed condition scales · aliases · closed values + other

g.title: draw
g.text: 4 · Select REAL and draw zero or more variations
Model, color, finish, edition, wear, damage, ageing, cleanliness
State, screen content, pose, camera, composition, aspect ratio

g.title: observe
g.text: Blind observation of the accepted SLOP
Same annotator, schema and lists as the REAL
No title, prompt or description · confirmed calls

g.title: scene
g.text: 5 · Sol prepares a complete scene on all eight axes
Plausible novelty and ordinary values · physical constraints
Peculiarities preserved or varied · explicit changes

g.title: confirm
g.text: Review scene and confirm maximum calls

g.title: generate
g.text: Final text only · dimensions match the aspect ratio

g.title: evaluate
g.text: Hardware, plausibility, peculiarities and parameter drift
Findings and suggested edits with benefits and risks

g.title: treatment
g.text: REAL references relevant to the target genre
Adjustable · no uniform filter across all SLOP
